name: token-saver
description: Cuts token spend without cutting accuracy: routes subagents to cheaper models, adds lean-output rules, stops duplicate file reads, shows a usage HUD and advises when to switch model.

routing.title: Subagent model routing
routing.description: balanced: search/lookup subagents (Explore, guides) run on Haiku. aggressive: also general-purpose and Plan subagents on Sonnet. off: never change a subagent's model.

leanRules.title: Lean-output rules
leanRules.description: Add a short system-prompt section telling Claude to skip preamble and recaps, read files in targeted ranges and batch tool calls.

dedupeReads.title: Duplicate-read guard
dedupeReads.description: Refuse, once, a Read of a file Claude already read in this context with the same range while it is unchanged on disk. A repeated identical call goes through, so the worst case is one extra round trip.

advisor.title: Model advisor
advisor.description: A toast when a prompt looks too simple for an expensive model, or too hard for a cheap one. Costs no tokens.
